prompt: The client wants to pick a city for its first pet grooming salons. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Boston is the largest market, at $80M
options.feedback: True, but Boston grows 3% a year and its leader holds 55%.

options.text: Denver offers the least concentration and fastest growth
options.feedback: Denver's leader is the smallest (15%), but Denver grows 8%; Austin grows 12%.

options.text: Austin offers size, 12% growth and a 20% leader
options.feedback: Right. Austin: $50M growing 12% with a 20% leader. Boston is bigger but slow (3%) and concentrated (55%).

options.text: Austin has the lowest rents of the three
options.feedback: The table doesn't show rents. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

explanation: Austin: $50M growing 12% with a 20% leader. Boston is bigger but slow (3%) and concentrated (55% leader).

extras.proof: Austin: $50M growing 12% with a 20% leader. Boston is bigger but slow (3%) and concentrated (55% leader).
